title: Jaxson Dart, Giants dismiss Cowboys for 28-20 win to open John Harbaugh era

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaxson Dart, Giants dismiss Cowboys for 28-20 win to open John Harbaugh era
sources.description: It didn’t take very long for the Giants to start looking like a John Harbaugh-coached team as they beat the Dallas Cowboys 28-20 on Sunday night to open the 2026 NFL season.
